confirmCancelPaid.title: Cancel a paid order
confirmCancelPaid.message: Order #{id} is paid, so the system will create a refund request. You transfer the money back from the Refunds page.

pending.title: {count, plural, one {# order needs action} other {# orders need action}}
pending.includes: Includes: new orders waiting for confirmation whose customer has no live QR code (did not choose to pay, or the code expired), and confirmed or paid orders waiting to be shipped.
pending.excludes: Excludes: orders whose customer is transferring right now (live QR code), shipping, delivered, completed or cancelled. So the total of waiting orders can be larger than this number.
pending.how: Open the order, confirm it and move it to "Shipping". If an unpaid order sits too long, contact the customer or cancel it.
